acceptanceCriteria: A prompt deriving more than 32 anchors yields a partial packet that keeps the first 32 in a deterministic order and names the dropped anchors
The refusal code remains only for inputs over the byte bound
body: Lane misc-1021i (PR #1453, V1-1976) reproduced it: a long prompt deriving more than 32 explicit anchors fails as unsupported-dogfood-context-bounds, and now surfaces as dogfood-event-prompt-bounds. Expected: cap or trim the derived query to the bound and return a partial packet that names the omitted anchors. Actual: the whole context is refused. This session's own hook shows the same thing: 37 anchors were derived, with 17 missing.

title: hook context: prompts whose derived query exceeds the 32-anchor bound are refused outright instead of degrading to a partial packet
